title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Tropical 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Tropical Nic Salt e-liquid captures a taste of the tropics with its vibrant blend of sweet Passion Fruit, juicy Guava, and ripe Pineapple. This e-liquid offers a refreshing and exotic vaping experience, perfect for those who enjoy rich, fruity flavours with a tropical twist. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are perfect for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. Each puff delivers smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it a great option for vapers seeking an enjoyable alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Tropical delivers a flavour-packed all-day vape. Pukka Juice is a UK-based, multi-award-winning vape brand known for its bold and creative flavour profiles. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range brings the intense flavours of disposable vapes to a more versatile format, perfect for reusable vape devices. Try other popular flavours from the collection, such as Raspberry Pomegranate, Pineapple Ice, and Berry Blast.
